?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:103018
Court No. - 44
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 19468 of 2024

Applicant :- Afsar Hussain And Another Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Devesh Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
1.Heard learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Sunil Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
2.This

application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to quash the charge sheet dated 20.01.2021, congnizance/summoning order dated 11.02.2021 as well as entire proceeding of Criminal Case No. 1196 of 2021 arising out of Case Crime No. 53 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323,
504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D. P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Jhansi, pending before Additional Civil Judge (J.D.)/Judicial Magistrate, Jhansi on the basis of compromise.
Afsar Hussain And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21685890/
1
3. Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that parties have settled their dispute amicably through written compromise dated 15.05.2024, therefore, the present case be finally decided.

4. Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 has also filed an affidavit of opposite party no.2 stating that parties have settled their dispute outside the Court and opposite party no.2 has no objection in case, proceeding of aforesaid case against the applicants is quashed.
5. Learned AGA does not dispute the fact that parties have entered into settlement.
It is further submitted that he would have no objection in case criminal proceedings are put to an end.
He further submits that in view of settlement there is virtually no chance of any conviction being recorded in the criminal proceedings.

6. In view of the fact that the parties do not want to pursue the case any further as stated by them and the fact that matter has been mutually settled between the parties in view of the compromise dated 15.05.2024, no useful purpose would be served in proceeding with the matter further.
The proceedings of the aforesaid case is hereby quashed.
7. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is, accordingly, allowed.

Order Date :- 10.6.2024 AKT  Afsar Hussain And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21685890/
